## Why the build fails

The error comes from `tsc`, not from Vite: **strict mode** rejects the implicit `any` in
[`runner.ts`](packages/core/src/runner.ts). Three ways to fix it:

1. Add the type annotation (recommended).
2. Cast with `as unknown as Run` — *not* a good idea.
3. Turn off `noImplicitAny`, which ~~hides~~ the problem.

> **Note:** the CI runs `pnpm typecheck` before the tests.

- [x] reproduce locally
- [ ] add a regression test
  - nested item with `code`
  * another bullet

```ts
export function parse(line: string): Run | null {
  const raw = JSON.parse(line) as unknown;
  return isRun(raw) ? raw : null;
}
```

```bash
pnpm --filter @agentry/core test -- --grep "parse"
```

```json
{ "strict": true, "noImplicitAny": true }
```

| Option | Default | Effect |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `strict` | `false` | Turns on every strict check |
| `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` | `false` | Index access may be `undefined` |

See <https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig> or the [handbook][ts] for more.
Images work too: ![diagram](./diagram.png "Architecture").

[ts]: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/ "Handbook"
